article.story: FAIRFIELD, Conn. -- — Amar'e Marshall had 16 points in Albany's 74-66 win against Sacred Heart on Wednesday. Marshall also had seven rebounds for the Great Danes (7-6). Byron Joshua scored 14 points and added nine rebounds and three steals. Sultan Adewale had 12 points and shot 6 of 9 from the field. The Pioneers (4-7) were led in scoring by Tanner Thomas, who finished with 16 points, nine rebounds and two blocks. Nyle Ralph-Beyer added 13 points for Sacred Heart. Bryce Johnson also had 10 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
